title: The Moment Cops Realize a Walmart Shopper is The Killer
description:
On August 13th, 2023, officers were dispatched in reference to two alleged murder suspects sighted in a Walmart store. What seemed to be a simple encounter at first, starts escalating soon. While the female was being chased down and arrested, another team of officers were deployed in order to capture the other suspect. After searching for him in the area, he was finally located in the parking lot of the store but upon seeing the cops, he quickly turned around and started running back inside. The current status of the case regarding both the suspects has been kept under the wraps by the Police Department as of now. We do know that both of them have been charged with menacing by stalking and the female has been additionally charged with murder. The identity of the victim has been kept hidden by the police department. We do not have any further information regarding this case as of today.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
